item.title: Millwall to mark Memorial Day this weekend
item.description: Millwall Football Club will host its annual 'Memorial Day' on Saturday as Sheffield United visit The Den in the Sky Bet Championship (kick-off 3pm). Memorial Day sees The Lions remember those loved ones lost by supporters across 2025, by way of a minute's applause before kick-off as the names entered appear on the big screen. item.title: Lions and Blades level at The Den
item.description: Millwall and Sheffield United played out a competitive 1-1 draw in the Sky Bet Championship at The Den on Saturday afternoon. Andre Brooks gave The Blades the lead 17 minutes in, but Mihailo Ivanovic equalised just two minutes later to ensure a share of the spoils in SE16. Alex Neil made one change to his starting XI, with Ivanovic coming in for Josh Coburn. Barry Bannan, meanwhile, was handed a place on the bench, with Derek Mazou-Sacko overcoming injury to join him.
